questions.question: Explain how to filter data based on text, numbers and dates. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Explanation 6 Marks Filtering allows users to display only specific data that meet certain conditions.  Text Filter: Filters data based on text conditions such as begins with, ends with, or contains.  Number Filter: Filters numbers using conditions like greater than, less than, equal to, or between.  Date Filter: Filters data based on dates such as today, yesterday, this month, or specific date ranges. This helps in analyzing large datasets efficiently.
